hypothesis: Linear magnetic discontinuities in the GEODAWN TMI_up150 residual, detected with an oriented elongated second-derivative ridge filter, mark unmapped fault traces when dots are placed at least 300 m from every USGS catalogue fault pixel.
target_class: Expert-labelled NEW faults not in the USGS catalogue (official problem page, Problem description: 'faults that are not contained within the current public USGS database')
layer_used: geodawn_extensions_u8.tif band 4 TMI_up150 (uint8 mirror, sha256 a35a9c6d2a14786f4dab85481ee59769213072f5dab5b2535ea82ae4d9bb7d9b, scale/offset undocumented; filter is linear so the unknown scale does not change ridge locations)
not_used: labels.tif in the detector (used only for the exclusion buffer and the report-only catalogue proxy)
physical_signature: elongated (sigma_along=6 px, 600 m) and narrow (sigma_across=1.5 and 2.5 px) negative second derivative across strike, 12 orientations 0-165 deg step 15, max over orientation and scale, absolute value
pipeline: footprint = finite pixels of sample_submission.tif (5,167,373 px); zero-valued TMI pixels inside footprint treated as missing (3,061 px)
regional removal: subtract normalized-convolution Gaussian (sigma 10 px); residual inside footprint only
oriented ridge response with normalized convolution across missing pixels; scale-normalised; robust z-score (1.4826*MAD)
exclude any pixel within 3 px (300 m) of a catalogue fault pixel (labels == 1) and within 3 px of the footprint edge
greedy selection in descending z; accept a pixel only if >= 3 px from every accepted dot; stop at budget
budget fixed at 37654 dots (= GEMSDOE32 champion count, to remove count as a confound)
output_convention: float32; 1.0 at dots; 0.0 inside footprint elsewhere; NaN outside footprint (official text: data outside the bounds is null or nan)
holdout_plan: No off-catalogue labels exist locally. Catalogue DTI is REPORT-ONLY and is expected to be low by design because dots are excluded from catalogue buffers. Leakage canary: AUC of z vs catalogue labels must be <= 0.90 (above 0.90 = leakage).
uniqueness_plan: audit_full_registry.py against all 489 pinned rasters in registry/focus_registry_manifest.json (9 repos, NOT global); thresholds rho<=0.90 and <=70% within 3 px
known_risks_to_flag: GEODAWN flight-line striping may produce oriented ridge responses aligned with survey direction (orientation histogram reported)
uint8 quantisation (256 levels) of the TMI mirror creates steps that a ridge filter can respond to
magnetic lows from alteration can be non-fault; dikes and lithologic contacts are linear magnetic features without displacement
experiment_budget: 1 of 3 experiments used (registration + amendment A1 counted as the same experiment)
verdict_rule: Cannot be promoted on local evidence alone: no off-catalogue labels exist locally, so no score-gate can pass. Uniqueness and format gates are necessary, not sufficient.

amendments.reason: Feasibility, not score: the pre-registered 37654-dot budget is unattainable under the pre-registered exclusions (greedy 3 px spacing after 3 px catalogue buffer and 3 px edge band yielded 35079 candidates; run failed closed with RuntimeError before any DTI, uniqueness or format result existed).
amendments.change: Budget becomes ALL surviving candidates (35079 expected). No other parameter changes.
amendments.effect: Dot count (35079) differs from the GEMSDOE32 champion (37654); count is therefore a confound that this candidate does not control.
